from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from lxml import etree

PATH = "/home/user/Desktop/lec17-gui-events.pptx"
BLUE = RGBColor(0x44, 0x72, 0xC4)

prs = Presentation(PATH)

nsmap = {
    "a": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main",
    "p": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main",
}

a = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"
p = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"

for idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    cSld = slide.element.find(f"{{{p}}}cSld")
    if cSld is None:
        print(f"slide {idx}: no cSld")
        continue
    # Remove existing bg if any
    bg = cSld.find(f"{{{p}}}bg")
    if bg is not None:
        cSld.remove(bg)
    # Create new bg with solid blue fill
    bg = etree.SubElement(cSld, f"{{{p}}}bg")
    # Insert bg at the beginning of cSld (must precede spTree)
    cSld.remove(bg)
    cSld.insert(0, bg)
    bgPr = etree.SubElement(bg, f"{{{p}}}bgPr")
    solidFill = etree.SubElement(bgPr, f"{{{a}}}solidFill")
    srgbClr = etree.SubElement(solidFill, f"{{{a}}}srgbClr")
    srgbClr.set("val", "4472C4")

prs.save(PATH)
print(f"Saved with blue background on {len(prs.slides)} slides")
